column1: # Reviewed drift (2026-11-09): native copy rewritten in the XML after the Flutter app was frozen (11-08).
# The ARB no longer holds the live wording of these keys. locale<TAB>name. Shrinks only: an entry whose XML
# matches the ARB again fails the drift test until it is dropped. Changing the ARB to match is the other way out.

# 2026-11-11: dropped the entries whose XML matches the ARB again; added the divergences found by the first full run (native English wording, and Spanish/Chinese/Arabic copy the translation pipeline or the native screens wrote after the ARB froze).
# 2026-11-11: native corrects Flutter's wrong place name 'Work' (archived empty text), the remove-server sentence's missing full stop, and the English '(99 %)' spacing.

# 2026-11-11: rule added in Drift (Inputs.owned): a key whose translation is recorded in translation-state/<tag>.tsv with the hash of the current English is pipeline output, not drift; its rows were dropped (3328 rows -> 56).
# 2026-11-11: problem reports no longer hold a log, so the row says what happens (other languages fall back to English until translated).
# 2026-11-12: Help > Tips mini tutorial "Make it yours" step 2 names all six styles (Glass and Signal were missing), spelled as the Style page spells them.
